programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This film tells the story of a Chinese illegal immigrant, Cheung Kwan-chow, and his journey in New York.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi and PI Lam (Dong jing gong lüe (2000)) steal 2 stolen USD100 plates in HK. Lam loses them - no US reward. Lam and his 3 cute angels try to get them again in Seoul as does JJ. Lots of fighting.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood

programme.title: Go Go Bus

Sementara Itu, Ia Membimbing Anak-Anak Untuk Memahami Diri Mereka Sendiri Dan Membuka Pikiran Mereka. Serta Mengarahkan Anak-Anak Untuk Mengeksplorasi Kehidupan Yang Bermakna, Membantu Mereka Fokus Pada Tugas Yang Ada Dan Belajar Mengelola Emosi Yang Mengganggu Mereka.

programme.title: Superbook
programme.desc: Animasi Religi Kristen Yang Menceritakan Petualangan Seru Chris Dan Joy, Bersama Robot Mereka Gizmo. Melalui Sebuah Alat Bernama Superbook, Mereka Bertiga Mampu Menjelajah Lorong Waktu, Bertemu Dengan Tokoh-Tokoh Alkitab, Dan Menjadi Saksi Mata Sejarah. Melalui Petualangan Mereka Inilah, Superbook Membawa Pesan Alkitab Kepada Generasi Anak-Anak Di Era Digital.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop

Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Hunter X Hunter
programme.desc: Kisah Hunter Hunter Berfokus Pada Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Bernama Gon Freecss, Yang Suatu Hari Menemukan Bahwa Ayahnya Yang Selama Ini Diberitahu Telah Meninggal, Masih Hidup Dan Sehat. Dia Mengetahui Bahwa Ayahnya, Ging Freecss, Adalah Seorang Hunter Legendaris. Terlepas Dari Kenyataan Bahwa Ayahnya Meninggalkan Gon Bersama Kerabatnya Untuk Mengejar Mimpinya, Gon Bertekad Untuk Mengikuti Jejak Ayahnya, Lulus Ujian Hunter, Dan Akhirnya Menemukan Ayahnya Untuk Membuktikan Dirinya Sebagai Hunter Dengan Haknya Sendiri.

programme.title: Beyblade X S3
programme.desc: Beyblade X Mengikuti Ancaman Baru Dari Zero Cross (Zero Kurasu) Dan Keluarganya Yang Berencana Membangun X Tower Baru Demi Sistem Beyblade Tandingan Dan Menghancurkan Menara Lama. Team Persona Harus Berjuang Melindungi X Tower Asli Dengan Menghadapi Anak-Anak Zero.

programme.title: Gavan Infinity
programme.desc: Menceritakan Kisah Reiji Doki, Penyelidik Polisi Federal Galaksi, Yang Mengemban Gelar Space Sheriff Gavan. Ia Menyelidiki Emorgear Energi Kehidupan Yang Bereaksi Terhadap Emosi Negatif Guna Menghentikan Ancaman Kriminal Lintas Dimensi Yang Dapat Meruntuhkan

programme.title: Adu Kelas

Program Ini Akan Menampilkan Praktik Sains Dari Kakak Ilmuwan, Pertunjukan Dongeng, Hingga Pertunjukan Bakat Siswa Seperti Menyanyi, Menari, Berolahraga, Dll. Pada Setiap Bagian Program Terdapat Pembelajaran Bagi Siswa Yang Dikemas Lebih Menyenangkan.

Sehingga Para Smurf Harus Mencari Cara Agar Tidak Ditangkap Oleh Gargamel Dan Azrael.

Dengan Kekuatan Star Core, Golden Boy Melompati Dimensi Ruang-Waktu Dan Mengancam Keseimbangan Alam Semesta. programme.title: Metal Cardbot

Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Boboiboy Galaxy

Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan.
